title: LingBench++: A Linguistically-Informed Benchmark and Reasoning Framework for Multi-Step and Cross-Cultural Inference with LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating linguistic reasoning and cross-cultural inference capabilities in LLMs through puzzles inspired by the International Linguistics Olympiad. The benchmark's subjects and themes (e.g., morphology, syntax, kinship) are purely linguistic or related to cultural conceptualization (like spatial orientation), without any evaluation component for religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
